articles.title: A Giant Storm Soaks the Northeast — and Even a Wedding Gets Washed Out
articles.summary: A slow, powerful nor'easter is flooding the northeast U.S. this weekend. About 100,000 homes lost power, and one marina owner says the water is rising inside his building for the first time since Hurricane Sandy.

articles.title: 700,000 People, One Pope, and a Giant Open-Air Mass in Paris
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV celebrated a huge open-air Mass in Paris on Saturday. About 700,000 people gathered at the Place de la Concorde. The Pope praised young people's 'energy and commitment.'

articles.title: Trump Cancels $1 Billion in Spending — Without Asking Congress First
articles.summary: President Trump is canceling nearly $1 billion that Congress approved. The money was for refugee services, migrant students, and minority businesses. A Republican senator says he broke the rules — and she's not happy about it.
